counter_semantics: counts_after_start is captured after descriptor startup plus 3-second warmup; idle_counts is the measured >=60s delta. file_scans counts direct list_card_paths calls, not OS syscalls.
frontier: Actual Workspace driver_manager and baseline driver_config_watcher production descriptors only; not whole-application memory/CPU/startup.
bytecode_policy: Fresh private PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX with -B and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE; no cache exists or is written.

normalization.qwenpaw_file: Absolute source prefix replaced by <baseline> or <repository>; suffix retained.
normalization.pycache_prefix: Absolute temporary directory parent replaced by <temporary>; unique child directory and pycache suffix retained.
normalization.other_fields: Unchanged; all numeric values, arrays, counters, versions, executable identity, summary and original raw SHA256 retained.
